parse.title: Kyiv
parse.wikitext:
Kyiv is the capital and most populous city of [[Ukraine]]. It lies on the [[Dnieper]] river in north-central Ukraine.

== History ==

The city has been a major political, cultural, and economic center for over a millennium. The city's modern boundaries were established after [[World War II]].

== Geography ==

Kyiv lies on both banks of the [[Dnieper]] river, which flows south through the city.
